Configure Slack for EMM on iPhone and iPad — restrict sign-in to your Enterprise Grid org, send users straight to your domain, and control copying, downloads, and which browser opens links.
These keys are read by the separate Slack for EMM app, not the consumer Slack app, and they only take effect once Enterprise Mobility Management is turned on for your Grid org.
The human-readable description of this payload. This description appears on the Detail screen.
The human-readable name for the profile payload. The name appears on the Detail screen and doesn’t need to be unique.

The reverse-DNS-style identifier for the payload. This identifier is usually the same as the TopLevel value, with an additional appended component. This string must be unique within the profile. During a profile replacement, the system updates payloads with the same ‘PayloadIdentifier’ and ‘PayloadUUID’ in the old and new profiles.
The payload type, which each payload domain’s reference page specifies.

The globally unique identifier for the payload. The actual content is unimportant, but must be globally unique. In macOS, use ‘uuidgen’ to generate UUIDs. During a profile replacement, the system updates payloads with the same ‘PayloadIdentifier’ and ‘PayloadUUID’ in the old and new profiles.
The version of this specific payload.
The human-readable string containing the name of the organization that provides the profile. This value doesn’t need to match the organization payload value in the enclosing dictionary.

Marks the device as enrolled and approved. Without it, sign-in from this device is refused when your Grid org has EMM turned on.
SlackAppConfig is the only value; it is the presence of the key that Slack checks.

Your organisation’s Slack domain, so users land on your sign-in page instead of having to type a workspace URL.
Enter the domain on its own — for the org at acme.enterprise.slack.com, enter acme.enterprise.
The only domains a user may sign in to from a managed device. An attempt to sign in to anything else is refused with a dialog saying only approved workspaces are allowed.
Slack’s key name still uses the older spelling. It is case-sensitive and cannot be renamed.
Whether members are stopped from copying messages and downloading files on a managed device.

The managed browser members must use to sign in and to open links from Slack.
Slack recognises Web@Work, Workspace One, Microsoft Edge, and Blackberry Access.
